stemMd: A person walks 11 m east and then 4 m west along a straight line. What is the net displacement?
explanationMd: Choose east as positive. The net displacement is 11−4=7 m east, while total distance travelled is 15 m. Keep these two quantities distinct.

distractorRationale.b: This gives total distance rather than displacement.
distractorRationale.c: This reverses the direction of the larger component.
distractorRationale.a: This adds distances and reverses direction.
